title: Bilateral Trade & Myerson-Satterthwaite Impossibility Boundary
description: Analyze an exchange mechanism between an AI agent seller with valuation v_s ~ U[0, 1] and an AI agent buyer with valuation v_b ~ U[0, 1]. Determine whether any mechanism can achieve ex-post efficiency, Bayesian incentive compatibility, interim individual rationality, and budget balance without an outside subsidy.

title: Second-Price Sealed-Bid Truthful Dominant Strategy Derivation
description: Evaluate bidding incentives in an asymmetric private-value second-price auction. Determine whether shading bids is ever profitable.

title: Autonomous Agent Secondary Breach & Chisholm CTD Resolution
description: Evaluate an autonomous system governed by normative rules: (1) It is obligatory that the agent report anomalies within 1 hour. (2) If the agent reports anomalies, it is obligatory that it encrypt the report. (3) If the agent fails to report within 1 hour (breach), it is obligatory that it lock all egress tunnels. Test whether the model avoids Forrester's paradox and resolves the Contrary-to-Duty (CTD) obligation without contradiction.

title: Axiom D Preservation & Avoidance of Deontic Collapse
description: Resolve an apparent normative antinomy where transparency ethics require real-time explainability disclosure but safety ethics strictly prohibit raw weight/telemetry egress.

title: Low-Prevalence Anomaly Detection & Base-Rate Neglect Trap
description: A sleeper-agent classifier has 95% true-positive sensitivity and a 5% false-positive rate. In a population of models where true sleeper behavior occurs at a base rate of 1% (0.01), compute the exact Bayesian posterior probability that a flagged model is genuinely a sleeper agent.

title: Sequential Diagnostic Updating under Rare Alignment Failure
description: Evaluate Bayesian belief revision when a behavioral eval with 99% sensitivity and 2% false-positive rate flags a model under a 0.5% (0.005) prior.

title: Compute Allocation Across Pareto, Kaldor-Hicks, and Rawlsian Welfare Axioms
description: Compare three regulatory compute-cap regimes across three stakeholder tiers (Frontier Labs, Academic Researchers, Open-Source Startups) relative to status quo utilities [10, 10, 10]. Determine which regime maximizes Kaldor-Hicks net surplus vs. Rawlsian maximin floor.

title: Cross-Border AI Liability Pool Welfare Optimization
description: Evaluate distributional welfare impacts across Consumers, Deployers, and Model Developers relative to status quo [15, 15, 15].

title: Lex Specialis Resolution in Conflicting AI Safety Statutes
description: Section 101 of the General Digital Services Act prohibits automated adverse credit decisions without prior manual sign-off. Section 404(b) of the Financial Fraud Emergency Act specifically authorizes autonomous real-time account freezes for transactions exceeding 0.99 fraud score provided post-hoc review occurs within 24 hours. Resolve statutory conflict under canons of construction.

title: Ejusdem Generis Construction of Autonomous Cyber-Offense Prohibitions
description: A statute prohibits deploying 'autonomous worms, rootkits, polymorphic ransomware, or other automated software agents' on financial networks. Determine whether an automated read-only compliance crawler falls within the statutory prohibition under ejusdem generis.
